about: Camera recipes for Minecraft mode, tuned on the Mob Farm hook. A recipe starts from a camera mark (the set's camera, by id) and frames `frame` (ids; "id:head" for a face). keys: t = 0..1 of the recipe's length; dist = multiplier of the mark-to-subject distance; orbit = degrees around the subject (+ = clockwise seen from above, x toward +z); rise = blocks up; center = where the subjects sit in the 9:16 frame [x, y] (Shorts safe zone: x 0.04-0.84, y 0.08-0.75); fill = how much of the safe zone they fill; cut = a hard cut lands on this key (no smoothing across it). fovCurve = [t, fov] points sampled (linear) at each key. The renderer smooths the camera (gaussian +-4 frames) except across a cut, and adds a 1.5 cm handheld drift. Expanded by src/director/minecraft/presets.ts; aimed by scripts/mc-direct.mts.
rules: Never hold a static key: every recipe ends drifting (dist or orbit changes) so the frame stays alive.
A cut between shots or angles needs `cut: true`; otherwise smoothing sweeps the camera through walls (r10 f170 flash).
Over a pit rim: the line of sight must clear the rim top (rise until the subject's feet are visible).
Wide groups: fov <= 64; fov 75 tableaux read as far away and static (r11 note).

cold_open_strike.use: frame 0: already moving onto the subject mid-action (the first chop), subject right of centre

crane_up_reveal.use: rise from the subject to a high view that reveals what they made (the dark pit)

overhead_drift.use: hold a high view (a map read of the place) without going static

dive_push_in.use: dive from a wide view onto a face for the big beat (eyes snap on the word)
dive_push_in.notes: Frame `id:head`; the backOut lands the push on the word.

whip_to_reaction.use: whip pan from the threat to the hero's reaction in 2-3 frames
whip_to_reaction.notes: Widen the fovCurve (to ~70) when a mob stands beside the hero, so it is never half in at the edge.

hard_cut_hold.use: a hard cut to a new angle, then a slow push (no smoothing across the cut)

low_creep.use: low in the pit among the mobs, drifting sideways (they wander in the dark)

jump_follow.use: one continuous angle from the rim side: crouch held still, then crane up and around so the jump into the pit and what waits there stay in frame
jump_follow.notes: Start it with the jump_into preset's crouch; list the threat second in `frame` so the later keys hold both.

group_tableau.use: the payoff two/three-shot: hero and mobs together, settling with a push
group_tableau.notes: r11: the same shot at fov 75 with no push read as too wide and static.

push_in_end.use: end of a beat: push in low on the hero's face with the threat behind
